title: Planetary Science: Astrogeology Profiles: Jake Bleacher
description: Meet Jake Bleacher, an astrogeologist in the solar system exploration division at Goddard Space Flight Center. He studies lava flows on the Earth and on other planets. Dr. Bleacher is also a participant in the Desert Research and Technology Studies (Desert R.A.T.S. or D-R.A.T.S.).
keywords: Geology, Physical Geography, Erosion/Sedimentation, Geomorphology, Rocks/Minerals, Volcanoes, Lava, Planetary Science, Earth, Plantes and Moons
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
